jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial service group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

We are looking for a long-term intern to join our Private Wealth Management Investement & Wealth Solutions department. You will be responsible to provide support to credit managers in their daily work, for all branches of BPAG and from an operational perspective.

• Start date: ASAP

• Duration: 12 months

• Employment rate: part-time

• Prerequisite: a tripartite internship agreement signed with your school

Your role

• Support in the preparation of regular reports for the attention of the Front Office and Management (past due credit limits, upcoming credit limits maturities, Missing Documentation).

• Perform manual monitoring of credit structures and collateral requirements (“special monitoring” situations that cannot be handled automatically).

• Handling of standard operational tasks such as credit card guarantees approval and booking, approval on repurchase requests on insurance policies, manual update of interest conditions on client’s current accounts etc.

• Monitor the conditions set when the credit request is approved.

• Draft simple credit documentation for standard cases (Luxembourg) and verify documentation prepared by other branches.

• Tracking and follow-up of overdue credits.

Your profile

Qualifications and experience:

• Currently puirsing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Finance, Economics or other related field

• First internship in a similar role.

Specific knowledge:

• Sound knowledge of credit products and related risks.

• Sound knowledge of banking operational processes and related risks.

Personal qualities:

• Detail-oriented with an analytical mindset.

• Strong organizational and communication skills.

• Team player, autonomous and flexible.

Language Skills:

•

• French: fluent level

• English: good knowledge (written and spoken)

Note

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.

By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

Your role

• Lead and oversee all tax processes for investment funds, ensuring accuracy and compliance.

• Monitor changes in tax legislation and evaluate their impact on existing processes, implementing necessary updates as required.

• Act as a key liaison with tax authorities, auditors, clients, and legal advisors on tax matters and regulatory inquiries.

• Proactively challenge and enhance processes for calculating and controlling tax figures to deliver high-quality service to clients.

• Stay up to date with tax developments across various jurisdictions (tax watch) and actively build a professional network.

• Manage tax-related risks, ensuring effective incident tracking and timely reporting to management.

• Serve as the main point of contact for all tax-related inquiries regarding funds, supporting both internal stakeholders (CRM) and external clients.

• Participate in client meetings and presentations as the subject matter expert on tax.

Your profile

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Economics, Finance or Engineering

• 7 years' experience in similar function

• Fluent in french and english

• Economic, financial and accounting knowledge

• Expertise in international tax environment

• Excellent skills in tax reporting and calculation for funds

• Comprehensive understanding of fund administration

• MFGA (Accounting system) knowledge

• Good knowledge of various financial instruments and their functioning

• Proficiency in IT tools, particularly Excel and SQL queries

• Client-focused with strong communication skills

• Demonstrates rigor, methodological approach, high stress tolerance, initiative, and a high degree of independence

• Priority management, self-organization

• Analytical mindset, problem-solving skills, ability to propose solutions

• Able to actively participate in operational projects

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial services group offers a comprehensive range of services for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions, and family office services.
As a Client Relationship Officer, you will be responsible for all operational aspects of daily banking activities. Your role will be to deliver a world-class client experience.

Your role

• Serving as the point of entry for all operational requests from bankers or clients.
• Leading the end-to-end account-opening process, taking the local regulatory specificities that determine documentation requirements into consideration.
• Ensuring a strict follow-up of documentation (including pendings, middle office andR&C lists) by contacting clients, in coordination with the banker in charge of the relationship.
• Managing documentation flows (archiving and processing physical and electronic forms).
• Leading KYC information-gathering where required, and updating supplementary records in the system when needed.
• Processing workflow requests in the system (client codifications, credit card requests, credit lines, pricing exceptions, etc.) and ensuring relevant client documentation is entered into the system (memos, orders, etc.).
• Coordinating closely with the zone’s Business Risk Manager to resolve any risk and compliance matters.
• Leading and organising, within the team, the prioritisation and remediation of any Key Risk Indicators flagged.
• Adhering to all existing policies and directives, and support the implementation of new ones where needed.
• Processing payments and transfers, while ensuring callbacks are systematically performed, and providing support for other transactional activities where needed.
• Fostering close ties with the relevant internal stakeholders (Voyages, Middle Office, R&C, etc.), learning about what they do and acting as their point of contact for the team.
• Ensuring telephone call coverage within the team.
• Supporting administrative tasks where required.

Your profile

• Bachelor's degree or similar.
• No less than 5 years’ experience in a similar role.
• Fluent in English and Spanish; French and Portuguese an advantage.
• Service orientated, with experience in dealing with private clients and supporting relationship managers.
• Firm grasp of wealth managers’ client documentation duties and related internal processes.
• Familiarity with regulatory dimensions (cross-border, R&C, PEP, CARA, FATCA, CRS etc.).
• Attention to detail.
• Able to work independently and diligently.
• Reliable and resilient, with a strong sense of responsibility and an ability to multi-task.
• Solution-oriented and proactive mindset.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and oral.
• Strong team spirit.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people.

Pictet Asset Management (Pictet AM) manages the assets of some of the world’s largest institutions, financial intermediaries and their clients. Our culture welcomes independent thinkers and centres around investment excellence, a long-term perspective and a dedication to client service.

Your role

You will reinforce the team by helping to ensure that all inherent risks associated with Pictet AM Swiss-domiciled funds are properly managed, assist with the continued development and implementation of the Pictet AM ManCo Risk Management framework including the investment risk management framework, and by helping the Head of ManCo Risk to provide senior management with information about the risks facing the business and the effectiveness of mitigating actions.

Your tasks will include :

• Assisting the Head of ManCo Risk in ensuring that investment risks are identified and appropriately managed.

• Ensuring that regulatory risks for Pictet AM Swiss-domiciled funds are properly managed.

• Independently reviewing and assessing potential investment breaches for Pictet AM Swiss-domiciled funds.

• Overseeing delegated investment controlling activities and risk management capabilities of delegated portfolio managers.

• Maintaining and updating fund risk profiles and ensuring that policies and procedures related to the activity are properly updated and maintained.

• Contributing to Pictet AM Swiss-domiciled fund events management (e.g. launches, mergers, etc.) from a risk perspective, and overseeing these events.

• Contributing to risk reporting to the governing bodies (e.g. executive management, Board of Directors).

• Contributing to preparing responses to regulators’ requests about risk-related topics and to the oversight of counterparty risk .

Your profile

• University degree (undergraduate or postgraduate), or a qualification deemed equivalent.

• CFA, CAIA or FRM would be an asset.

• Three to five years’ experience in a similar role (investment and regulatory risk management) in the asset management industry.

• In-depth understanding of the asset management industry (portfolio management, trading, administration and fund distribution).

• Experience in counterparty risk management.

• Good knowledge of Swiss requirements in terms of risk management and of Swiss regulations for asset management and funds (knowledge of the Luxembourg regulatory environment would be an asset).

• Sound financial knowledge.

• Fluent in French and English; German would be a plus.

• Skilled user of standard IT applications (MS Office).

• Must be resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate.

Ref: RM/CT/ETNT

jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet North America Advisors SA (PNAA) provides investment services to private clients. Founded in 2007, the SEC-registered company devises portfolio diversification strategies for clients based in the US and Canada.

We are seeking to recruit a Client Relationship Officer for our US clients (UHNWI) on an 8 months contract. You will be working for PNAA in Geneva and will be the point of entry for all operational requests from relationship managers or clients. As most of our clients custody their assets with Banque Pictet & Cie SA, you will also work closely with its organization for outsourced custodian activities.

Your role

Your responsibilities will include the following:

• Assisting the CRM with daily client-related tasks (debit list, maturities, etc.).

• Processing payments and transfers while ensuring that call-backs are systematically performed, and assisting with other transactional activities when needed.

• Ensuring strict follow-up of documentation (pending items, Middle Office, Risk & Compliance lists) by contacting clients, together with the CRM responsible for the relationship.

• Managing documentation flows (archiving and processing physical and electronic forms).

• Processing workflow requests in the systems (client codifications, credit card requests, credit lines, pricing exceptions, etc.) and ensuring that the relevant client documentation is captured in the systems (memos, orders, etc.).

• Working closely with the zone’s COO and CCO to resolve any Risk & Compliance matters.

• Leading and organizing the prioritization and remediation of Key Risk Indicators within the team.

• Building close relationships and an understanding with the relevant custodian stakeholders (Middle Office, Client Registrar, Risk & Compliance, etc.) and serving as their point of contact for the team.

• Ensuring that all telephone calls received by the team are dealt with.

• Helping with administrative tasks when required.

Your profile

• Certification in Commerce/Banking, or an equivalent qualification.

• Minimum of 2–3 years’ experience as an assistant working in private banking.

• Service-oriented, with experience and understanding of dealing with private clients and assisting relationship managers.

• Understanding client documentation and the internal processes of a wealth management company

• Keen attention to detail.

• Able to work independently and diligently.

• Reliable and resilient with a strong sense of responsibility and an ability to multi-task.

• Solution-oriented and with a proactive mindset.

• Excellent communication skills, both written and oral.

• Keen sense of ethics, values and partnership culture.

• Strong team spirit.

• Fluency in English and French.

• Must be resident in Switzerland.

Votre équipe

FundPartner Solutions propose une gamme complète de services d’administration de fonds et de création de fonds sur mesure. Ses équipes de spécialistes apportent leurs compétences en matière de domiciliation, d’enregistrement et de gouvernance de fonds, ainsi que de gestion des risques et de contrôle du respect des directives de placement.

En tant que Business Compliance & Operations Liaison Officer vous serez responsable de la gestion et de la coordination des projets entre les diverses équipes de la société ainsi qu’avec les prestataires externes de type gestionnaires de fortune collective. Vous assurerez un support opérationnel de qualité, coordonnerez les flux d’information et veillerez à la conformité des processus liés à l’administration et à la gouvernance des fonds d’investissement de droit suisse. Ce rôle est essentiel pour garantir une efficience optimale et le respect des exigences réglementaires lors de la mise en place et du suivi de fonds d’investissements.

Votre rôle

• Agir comme point de contact principal pour les équipes internes (juridique, compliance, risques, administration fonds) sur les aspects opérationnels et administratifs.
• Gérer la coordination légale et opérationnelle des projets liés à la mise en place de nouveaux fonds ou mandats de gestion, en collaboration avec les départements internes et externes (gérants, autorité, audit, etc).
• Coordonner et suivre les projets clients, en veillant à la collecte des documents, au respect des délais et à la bonne communication entre les parties prenantes pour assurer leur mise en œuvre.
• Assurer la mise à jour, la gestion et la publication des données des fonds de placement dans les systèmes internes, ainsi que la production de rapports réglementaires et opérationnels.
• Gérer la coordination et la préparation administrative des demandes provenant de diverses autorités (FINMA, AFC, etc) ainsi que des demandes d’audit interne et externe participer aux activités et tâches liées à la gouvernance d’entreprise.
• Soutenir opérationnellement les équipes dans le suivi et l’implémentation des documents et des contrats de la société et participer au processus clé de vérification nécessaires pour les divers processus de la société.
• Participer à l’amélioration continue des processus, à l’optimisation des outils de travail et à la préparation de documents pour les clients et comités internes.

Votre profil

• Solide expérience (5-10 ans) dans le secteur bancaire ou financier, avec formation supérieure (Bachelor ou équivalent).
• Bonne connaissance des produits financiers et des processus opérationnels en environnement financier.
• Maîtrise des réglementations suisses et internationales, avec curiosité et capacité à en comprendre les enjeux.
• Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais (l’allemand est un atout), avec de bonnes compétences en communication.
• Maîtrise des outils MS Office et sens de l’organisation pour gérer plusieurs tâches en parallèle.
• Esprit d’équipe, orientation client, rigueur, autonomie et capacité à résoudre des problèmes.
• Domicile en Suisse requis.

Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Pictet Asset Services provides custody, fund services and trading solutions for external asset managers, fund managers and institutional clients. We manage every aspect of the asset servicing value chain and our range of bespoke solutions include value-adding analytics, trading strategy support and digital front-end interfaces designed to provide an unrivalled customer experience.

As an intern within the Pictet Asset Services department, you will support the Client Relationship Management (CRO/CRM) teams in their daily activities. This internship will allow you to develop operational, regulatory, and interpersonal skills while contributing to the quality of client service.

• Start date: August/September

• Duration: 12 months

• Employment rate: part-time

• Prerequisite: a tripartite internship agreement signed with your school

Your role

• Provide daily operational support to the teams in managing client files: preparation, verification, and follow-up of documents required for account opening, modification, or closure.

• Assist in the management of routine operations: signature verification, execution and monitoring of transactions (orders, payments, fund and asset transfers), management of incoming/outgoing flows, coordination with counterparties, and alerting in case of blockages.

• Participate in the preparation and updating of client files, ensuring information compliance and completeness of supporting documents.

• Support the teams in handling client requests, processing queries, and resolving simple incidents, ensuring rigorous follow-up and effective communication.

• Contribute to verifying the accuracy of transactions and the quality of data entered into internal tools.

• Act as a point of contact for administrative and logistical tasks related to client relationship management.

Your profile

Qualifications and experience:

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration or Economics.

• First experience (internship) in a client relationship management role within the financial services industry, idealy in private banking or wealth management

Personal qualities:

• Attention to detail and organizational skills

• Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

• Strong interpersonal skills and a team-oriented mindset

• Proactive and solution-oriented approach

Language Skills:

• French: fluent level

• English: good knowledge (written and spoken)

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer-Cloud Engineering
jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Tech designs, integrates and operates software applications ranging from portfolio management systems and trading platforms to banking and corporate solutions. The division is responsible for some of the Group’s key innovations while sustaining business operations.

You’ll be part of the Cloud Engineering unit. In this unit, we are responsible of streamlining the development experience of product teams by delivering reliable and user-centric platforms covering observability, identity, continuous integration and delivery, release management and cloud capabilities.
You will be embedded within the Release Management Team and will help building and maintaining the tooling used to manage and govern the release management at Pictet Tech .

Your role

• Designing, building and operating a reliable platform providing release management capabilities to development teams.

• Contributing to the promotion of good practices in terms of Release Management within Pictet Group.

• Aligning with developers, infrastructure engineers, cybersecurity and risk managers to apply standards and to provide guidance.

• Performing tasks expected of a platform engineer: development, infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines.

Your profile

• You have experience in an engineering role (e.g., software engineer, devops, etc.).

• Proficiency in software craftsmanship practices and full stack development (i.e. Java, Spring, Typescript, Angular, Next.js).

• A well-established background in vibe coding paired with a strong passion for AI coding.

• Knowledge about architecture topics such as integration, security, network, identity and access management.

• Strong interest and knowledge of release management processes.

• As a plus, you have expertise in releasing core banking systems or such complex systems within a highly regulated environment.

• Team player with strong communication and interpersonal skills.

• Deeply curious and eager to learn technologies and skills.

• Fluent in French and English.

• Swiss resident.

Ref: DOE/CRO/XC

We will not accept any CVs via agencies
